name: @ailearn/desktop
description: AI Learn — macOS desktop launcher (frontend lifecycle only)
author: AI Learn Team

scripts.prebuild:web: cd ../../apps/web && npm install && NEXT_PUBLIC_QUESTION_FIRST_UI_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_QUESTION_V1_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_RUBRIC_EVALUATION_V1_ENABLED=true npm run build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/apps/web/.next && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -r public .next/standalone/apps/web/public
scripts.dist: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --arm64
scripts.dist:universal: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --universal
